{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10 (was µg/L, should be ng/mL)
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute proportion of severe cases in treatment arm
treatment_severe_count = df[(df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (df['severity'] == 'severe')].shape[0]
treatment_total_count = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
treatment_severe_prop = treatment_severe_count / treatment_total_count

# Compute proportion of severe cases in control arm
control_severe_count = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'severe')].shape[0]
control_total_count = df[df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
control_severe_prop = control_severe_count / control_total_count

print(f'Proportion of severe cases in treatment arm: {treatment_severe_prop:.3f}')
print(f'Proportion of severe cases in control arm: {control_severe_prop:.3f}')"}
